final: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic), AVG(p.ratio), AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) FROM per_patient AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio
